summary: BGSF, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting, managed services, and professional workforce solutions in the United States. The company operates through The Property Management segment, that offers office and maintenance field talent to various apartment communities and commercial buildings. It serves its products to medium and small companies, as well as consulting companies. BGSF, Inc. was formerly known as BG Staffing, Inc. and changed its name to BGSF, Inc. in February 2021. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
